title: Build TaskFlow Lite in React
goal: Rebuild TaskFlow Lite in React while keeping state ownership, derived values, effects, and component boundaries easy to explain.
steps: Start with one component and static data.
Split presentation into TaskList and TaskItem using props.
Add `useState` for the authoritative task list and form input.
Use functional state updates for changes that depend on previous state.
Keep filtered/searched tasks derived instead of storing a second list.
Extract the create form as a controlled component.
Add a custom hook for localStorage synchronization with cleanup/error handling where needed.
Inspect re-renders with React DevTools and remove one unnecessary state/effect.
Rebuild one feature without looking at the reference.
evidence: A clean Git diff or file-tree change
Browser, HTTP, database, test, container, or CI evidence that proves the behavior
One deliberate failure, the evidence you used, and the root-cause fix
A short explanation of why the final responsibility lives in the chosen layer
completion: I can reproduce one key part without the walkthrough.
I can explain one trade-off I deliberately chose.
I can show one failure that my tests, constraints, or runbook now protects against.
